definitions.explanation: A white powder (sodium bicarbonate) used in cooking, cleaning, and various household applications. Also called sodium hydrogen carbonate.

examples.japanese: {重曹|じゅうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧。
⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重曹|じゅうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add a little baking soda when making sweets.

examples.japanese: {重曹|じゅうそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧や⟦{消臭|しょうしゅう}→消臭：21552_shoushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{万能|ばんのう}→万能：08818_bannou⟧⟦アイテム→アイテム：07813_aitemu⟧だ。
examples.english: Baking soda is a versatile item that can be used not only for cooking but also for cleaning and deodorizing.

notes:
The Japanese name literally means "double carbonate" ({重|じゅう} = double/layered + {曹|そう} = carbonate). A staple household product in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重曹|じゅうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧ (to dissolve baking soda)
- {重曹|じゅうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean with baking soda)
- {重曹|じゅうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}りかける→振りかける：21485_furikakeru⟧ (to sprinkle baking soda)

Popular in Japan as a natural cleaning agent. Often featured in household tips and life hack articles. In cooking, it is used as a leavening agent and to soften dried beans.
